Muslim Studies Program
The Muslim Studies
Option
offers:
An interdisciplinary/multi-disciplinary approach to the study of
Islam and Muslim societies that integrates perspectives and
methodological approaches from both the humanities and social sciences.
The study of the historical, philosophical and theological
development of Islamic thought and traditions as well as contemporary
sociological, political and cultural contexts of lived Muslim
experiences within a broad geographic context that incorporates a
global, transnational as well as local focus.
An emphasis on an integrative analysis of Islam and Muslims from
historical, scriptural, philosophical, cultural and gender perspectives
that inform the contemporary global relations between Muslims and
non-Muslims.
